top news.title: Meta launches Muse Image in Meta AI, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and previews Muse Video, the first media generation models from its Superintelligence Labs

tweets.author: @alexandr_wang
tweets.text: 1/ releasing muse image today — the first image generation model from MSL. it's agentic: pairs with muse spark to reason through your prompt, search the web, and plan before it generates. people get what they meant on the first try. live now in the Meta AI app. [image]

tweets.author: @aaditsh
tweets.text: This is being framed as an image model but it's actually @Meta's ad business in a new costume.  98% of Meta's Q1 revenue ($56.3B) comes from ads.  Advantage+ is already cutting cost per lead for advertisers.  And Muse Image goes into Advantage+ within weeks

tweets.author: @ml_angelopoulos
tweets.text: Meta just released video/image models that beat Sora and Nano Banana. The narrative 6 mo ago was that @AIatMeta was unsalvageable. Now they are ahead. Video/Image is particularly strategic, given Meta's distribution to consumers (Insta, WA). Don't fuck with Zuck [image]

sub_items.title: As part of Meta's Muse Image rollout, Instagram users with public accounts need to opt out to block AI generations of their content by other users

top news.title: Sources: China met with Alibaba, ByteDance, Z.ai, and others to discuss potentially limiting foreign access to advanced AI models, penalties for AI theft, more

tweets.author: @akarlin
tweets.text: Europe is at the point where, if it was smart, it would negotiate the terms of its surrender to the US on maximally favorable conditions, while it still retains some leverage (mostly ASML and the Germanic machine tool building complex). This window won't remain open indefinitely.

tweets.author: @afinetheorem
tweets.text: Today in “US is not unique, nor is closed-source; no country will allow unrestricted use and export of frontier dual use intelligence models”. Can't stress enough for middle powers that “ensure access to frontier AI” is going to be more important than “be sovereign from US/China”

tweets.author: @deanwball
tweets.text: We don't know whether this will happen, but it's been surprising that discussions of open-weight AI broadly, and Chinese open-weight in particular, operate in an alternate reality where government security concerns don't exist, or somehow only apply to closed-weight models.

top news.title: Anthropic expands Claude Cowork to web and mobile in beta for Max plan subscribers, and says 90%+ of Cowork usage is unrelated to software development

tweets.author: @shanumathew93
tweets.text: Let's go! Been functional leaving laptop on at home but having this truly seamless and not dependent on leaving your laptop on at home will be excellent Picking up Cowork + Codex work from phone while you're out is epic

tweets.author: @codebypoonam
tweets.text: damn.. Claude Cowork just stopped needing your laptop open. hand it a task at your desk, close the laptop, and it keeps working. scheduled tasks now run even with your computer completely off. set client prep for 6am.  Claude reads your threads, builds the brief, drafts the follow-up, and leaves it unsent for you to review. when it needs your judgment, the question comes to your phone. now on mobile, web, and desktop. same session, any device.

tweets.author: @claudeai
tweets.text: Scheduled tasks now run even with your computer off. Set client prep for 6am, and Claude works through the threads and transcripts, builds the brief, and leaves the follow-up drafted but unsent. When a decision needs your judgment, the question comes to your phone.

Sources: Microsoft, looking to reduce AI costs, is starting to replace models from OpenAI and Anthropic with its MAI models in products like Excel and Outlook
Google announces a Pixel event on August 12 in NYC, where it is expected to launch Pixel 11 series of phones and Pixel Watch 5
Samsung announces a Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22 in London, where it is expected to debut new foldables, including a Fold 8 with a shorter and wider design
Sources: Amazon is looking to raise at least $25B from a US dollar bond sale to fund its AI infrastructure investments; the size could increase based on demand
UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls for autonomous “killer robots” to be “banned by international law”, a central issue in the US DOD-Anthropic clash

artificial intelligence.title: Paris-based UMA, founded by ex-Tesla Optimus scientist Rémi Cadene and ex-Google DeepMind researcher Pierre Sermanet, demos its Northstar AI humanoid robot
OpenAI Chief Futurist Joshua Achiam is leaving the company later this month after nearly nine years
Memo: SpaceXAI and Cursor plan to launch their first jointly developed AI model as soon as Wednesday, after pushing back the launch to improve model efficiency
Anthropic plans to lease a 16-story building in Lower Manhattan and double its NYC workforce to 1,000 people this year, as AI companies expand in the city
European banking watchdogs ECB and ESRB warn that frontier AI models pose “systemic risks to the financial system”, and give lenders four months to prepare
Survey: Chinese companies plan to allocate 46% of their AI accelerator budget to domestic products in the next 12 months, up from 30% today, a shift from Nvidia
Alibaba's Qwen models, introduced in 2023, have made it an AI powerhouse, but the company has yet to turn their global popularity into a profitable business

Coinbase secures UK FCA authorization to offer investment services, enabling it to expand into derivatives and equities trading, its largest UK expansion yet

Tangos, which uses AI to conduct financial crime investigations at scale, raised a $20M seed led by Red Dot

A profile of Rachel Whetstone, who has led comms for Google, Meta, Uber, Netflix, and now Sierra, as her husband Steve Hilton runs for governor of California
A profile of Bernadette Meehan, a US diplomat who became Wikimedia Foundation's CEO in January, as Wikipedia faces threats from MAGA, AI, and foreign autocrats
